title: Show HN: Getting GLM 5.2 running on my slow computer
summary: The author tested GLM 5.2 (a Chinese large language model) on their low-spec computer and was impressed by its capabilities comparable to Claude or GPT. Working with AI agents, they developed a solution to run this capable LLM locally without running out of memory, making advanced AI accessible to users with limited hardware.
problem_solved: Enables running capable large language models like GLM 5.2 on low-resource computers without memory overflow issues.
why_valuable: Democratizes access to advanced AI by allowing users with limited hardware to run powerful LLMs locally without cloud dependencies or costs.
